channel.title: The h5i Blog
channel.description: Design essays on giving an AI agent a browser you can audit: boundaries, evidence, and what a request log has to prove.

item.title: AI pentesting tools: Burp Suite, ZAP, Caido, or h5i?
item.description: Burp Suite, ZAP, Caido, and h5i compared for AI pentesting: AI-assisted manual testing, AI-authored scan automation, and agent-led investigation.

item.title: Sandbox the entire workflow: browse, develop, review, apply
item.description: Create one sandbox for an AI coding task, browse from inside it, develop and test there, then review the evidence before exporting or applying the patch.

item.title: Why sandbox the entire AI agent workload
item.description: AI coding agents run package scripts, compilers, tests, servers, and browsers. Sandboxing the whole workload limits what mistakes and untrusted code can reach.

item.title: Five tiers, five different promises
item.description: Choose coding-agent isolation by threat model: checkout separation, process confinement, L3/L4 egress control, portable containers, or a separate kernel.

item.title: A transcript is not an audit trail
item.description: Review agent-written code with evidence collected outside the agent: the patch, observed execution, denied activity, and explicit gaps in observation.

item.title: How to protect a coding agent from prompt injection
item.description: A coding agent reads whatever the repository and the web put in front of it, and some of that text will tell it to do harm. h5i limits what the agent's process can read, which credentials it holds, where it can connect, and what it can merge, so a successful injection has nowhere to go.

item.title: Burp Suite vs h5i for AI agents
item.description: Compare Burp Suite and h5i for AI-assisted pentesting, CTFs, and authorized red teaming: proxy depth, agent interfaces, HTTP replay, recon, scope, isolation, and audit evidence.

item.title: OWASP ZAP vs h5i for AI agents
item.description: Compare OWASP ZAP and h5i for AI-assisted web security testing: automated scanning, spiders, APIs, agent browsing, HTTP replay, scope enforcement, isolation, and evidence.

item.title: Caido vs h5i for AI agents
item.description: Compare Caido and h5i for AI-assisted pentesting: proxy history, Replay, Automate, HTTPQL, workflows and agent skills versus bounded browsing, recon, sandboxing, and audit evidence.
